# proxmox_storage_rrd_image (Data Source)

Reads a storage RRD graph PNG as base64 from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/rrd`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_rrd_image" "i" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  storage   = "local"
  timeframe = "hour"
  cf        = "AVERAGE"
  ds        = "used"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cf` (String)
- `ds` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `timeframe` (String)

### Read-Only

- `image` (String)
